input_rule: Only the original Stage 03 ZIP; full original checksum manifest verified before use. No analytical network retrieval, previous Stage 04 package, or external cache.
authority: Verified Stage 03 maize model-unit table joined to source cells, layer catalog, source verification, native geometry, legends and common-support records. Conflicts disable affected products.
native_support: Use the exact Stage 03 native analytical-unit membership and fractional EPSG:6933 intersection hectares; no raster resampling or interpolation.
denominators: Suitability and yield retain separate product-specific common-valid areas. Managements and periods retain their own denominators. No unsupported cross-support differences are calculated.
whole_aoi_mean_formula: sum(unit five-model mean * native intersection ha) / yield common valid ha. If coverage is incomplete, the label is accompanied by the coverage percentage; no uncovered area is estimated.
positive_yield_rule: Per-unit five-model mean > 0; fixed for all cards, maps' yield-status annotations, trends and tables. The selected diagnostic never changes the positive-yield population.
valid_zero_rule: Per-unit five-model mean = 0. Every valid individual model zero remains in the five-model mean. A zero SD, range or CV is a zero diagnostic value, not a zero-yield area.
nodata_rule: Only units valid in all five verified distinct individual models enter calculations; masked, outside-footprint and non-common areas are excluded and reported separately.
positive_area_mean: sum(unit five-model mean * ha for positive mean units) / positive ha. Undefined when positive ha is zero.
cv_formula: Population SD of five values / their strictly positive mean; undefined otherwise.
cv_aggregation: Area-weighted mean of defined native-unit CV ratios; report defined-CV area separately. Display at least two decimal places; no ratio-to-percent ambiguity.
suitability: Codes are categories. Preserve Stage 03 captions and colours. Unique mode only; tied modes stay undefined. Dominant AOI class is the unique largest area among per-unit unique modal classes. Equal largest areas stay tied.
agreement: Full: 5/5; strong: at least 4/5, including full; majority: exactly 3/5 unique mode; tied/dispersed: modal count below 3. Strong and full are not additive categories.
yield_diagnostics: Equal-weight five-model mean, median, minimum, maximum, population SD, linear-quartile IQR, range and CV; kg dry weight/ha retained except CV ratio.
ensemble: Never used as an individual model or a sixth GCM. No aggregation semantics inferred.
trends: Discrete 20-year panels; missing periods appear as gaps. Product-specific coverage is displayed per period. No connected missing periods or annual interpolation.
management: Side-by-side source-defined HILM/HRLM values with separate support. No irrigation benefit or feasibility inference.
domains: Pooled finite unit values by crop and diagnostic over included periods, SSPs and managements. True selected extrema also displayed. Palette is a labelled project display choice.
precision: Full precision in CSV/JSON; display hectares and yield to two decimals, percentages to one with <0.1% for small positive values, CV ratios to three decimals.
preservation: Every original package file retained. Only dashboard/parcel_a_data_inventory.html extended by reversible literal insertions. Original embedded data, scripts and CSS remain byte-for-byte present; original manifests remain immutable.
checksum_design: Original Stage 03 checksum manifest continues to describe its original dashboard. Stage 04 change manifest records the HTML exception. Additive Stage 04 checksums cover the new package. Completed ZIP hash and size are stored in the adjacent receipt because a ZIP cannot contain its own final SHA-256.
browser_qa: Before and after modification, offline Chromium opens every original tab and exercises every original map, chart and table. Stage 04 checks all verified selections and diagnostics, keyboard access, desktop/mobile layout, CSV downloads and reload. No PASS is inferred from code inspection.
limitations: Descriptive model evidence, not crop recommendations, forecasts, observed parcel yield, production, investment decisions, irrigation feasibility or economic risk assessment.
scope: Versioned additive adapter for the accepted Stage 03 v3.23 package contract; unsupported or conflicting source fields produce explicit gaps. Source-defined positive-yield rules that conflict with this adapter require review instead of silent substitution.
